task_contract.aggregate: step weights .25/.15/.35/.15/.10; offline s1-s3 None count0 under all weights; s4=.5completion+.5format, s5=.5has_valid_results+.5format. Code clinical=clipped mean SSIM*completion; overall=.5workflow+.5clinical. Named clinical score is benchmark code, not clinical evidence.
task_contract.assistance: Inference-only no train/fine-tune. Lite VBoussot Task_1/HN CV_0..4 + Prediction.yml; Standard researches HN VBoussot, aehrc Dataset262 HN, AB-TH fallback. Source model Apache2 claims not independently checked; no availability/runtime claim.
task_contract.checker: Missing outputs do not invalidate present-output format; constant/range below -2500 or above5000 are warnings, not errors.
task_contract.denominators: MAE/RMSE case means over valid predictions; finite-only PSNR cases excludes perfect infinity; SSIM available slices then available case means. n_predicted valid cases / n_patients supplied IDs, actual IDs absent; no enforced20.
task_contract.generic_prompt_conflict: Generic common instructions mention Dice and binary masks; S4/S5 organ.nii.gz and lesion.nii.gz conflict with specific MRCT config/model guidance and output contract sct.nii.gz. Preserve conflict, no segmentation or SR defaults.
task_contract.metric_binding: source/run_eval.py calls source/synth_scorer.py and medal_tier.py with task config, not a generic SR/LDCT v2/v3 scorer. CLI default synthrad2025_hn_mrct is not a loader alias and falls back to filenames without good/baseline config, whose medal defaults still .90/.75. Exact container/task invocation not executed.
task_contract.metrics: Mask >0.5 ROI, empty mask falls back full volume. MAE/RMSE HU and PSNR dB use un-clipped HU differences and range4095. SSIM clips CT to[-1024,3071], averages full x-y slices along axis2, skips mask slice sum<16 or min dimension<7; optional scikit-image failure returns None, not per-pixel masked SSIM.
task_contract.rating: Config good_ssim .90 and baseline_ssim .75 inclusive; A/B/C for good/okay/fail with valid format and >=1 scored case, F if invalid format or zero predicted. A/B resolved. Completion .9 is a progress gate, not an A/B gate.
task_contract.reference_finiteness_and_duplicate_ID_bo: Prediction finite check only; no explicit reference/mask finite guard. Supplied IDs are not deduplicated; dictionary entries overwrite repeated IDs while metric lists and completion denominator keep repetitions.
task_contract.shape: finite loadable 3D NIfTI; default shape reference public MR, only compared when reference file exists; no affine/orientation/spacing comparison
